knowledge_point.title: Finding the Reduced Row Echelon Form of a Singular 3x3 System With One Pivot

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-8x+16y-24z &=32 \\ 7x-14y+21z &=-28 \\ 4x-8y+12z &=-16\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-8 & 16 & -24 & 32 \\ 7 & -14 & 21 & -28 \\ 4 & -8 & 12 & -16\end{array}\right].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
R_1:=(-\frac{1}{8})R_1
$$



$$
M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & -4 \\ 7 & -14 & 21 & -28 \\ 4 & -8 & 12 & -16\end{array}\right].
$$



$$
R_2:=R_2+(-7)R_1
$$



$$
M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 4 & -8 & 12 & -16\end{array}\right].
$$



$$
R_3:=R_3+(-4)R_1
$$



$$
M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -2 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
R_1:=(-\frac{1}{8})R_1
$$



$$
M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -8 & 9 & -10 \\ 7 & -56 & 63 & -70 \\ 4 & -32 & 36 & -40\end{array}\right].

$$

$$



$$
R_3:=R_3+(-4)R_1
$$



$$
M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -8 & 9 & -10 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right].
